title: sambucus sieboldiana f. platyphylla
intro: Sambucus sieboldiana f. platyphylla, commonly known as Japanese elder, is a shrub-like plant belonging to the Adoxaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds and flu, as well as reduce fever and improve immune function. The therapeutic actions of Japanese elder include its ability to stimulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and act as an antiviral agent. The bioactive constituents of Sambucus sieboldiana f. platyphylla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
